name: mdbindery
summary: Build EPUB 3 ebooks or paginated PDFs from Markdown chapters and mdBook projects. EPUB is the default; unreleased PDF export requires a source install with the pdf extra.
author: Taras Baranyuk

skills.name: mdbindery
skills.purpose: Operate mdbindery CLI: install, doctor, init, check, build, preview, read JSON/Markdown reports and build gates.

skills.name: mdbindery-prepare-repo
skills.purpose: Resolve reported findings in a Markdown repository or mdBook while preserving author meaning and GitHub rendering.

install.pypi_uv: uv tool install mdbindery && mdbindery install-tools

doctor.description: Verify installed tools (pandoc, epubcheck, java, node, mermaid, ace, python).

exit_codes.0: Required tools (pandoc >= 3.8, EPUBCheck) installed; missing Node tools only print notes.

init.description: Infer book structure and write a starter mdbindery.yaml configuration file in path (default: .).

exit_codes.1: mdbindery.yaml already exists (without --force) or no Markdown chapters found.
exit_codes.2: Folder not found or existing config invalid (without --force).

check.syntax: mdbindery check [target] [-c FILE] [--ref REF] [--build] [--no-render] [--report FILE] [--json FILE] [-q]
check.description: Dry-run static and pandoc analysis on a local folder or Git/GitHub URL. Reports MB001-MB904 findings with severity, suggested fix, and file and line where available. The optional --build trial builds EPUB only.

exit_codes.0: No errors found (warnings and info notes allowed).
exit_codes.1: At least one error found (or trial build failed with --build).
exit_codes.2: Target unreadable or report file cannot be written.

build.description: Build <slug>.epub by default or <slug>.pdf with --format pdf. Both run source gates. EPUB adds EPUBCheck, Ace and per-chapter word counts; PDF checks resources, internal links and extracted text. EPUB reports use reports/; PDF reports use reports/pdf/. The includes gate appears only on failure. PDF leaves source configuration unchanged.

exit_codes.0: Selected book format built; no active gate failed.
exit_codes.1: Book written, but at least one validation gate failed.
exit_codes.2: Configuration or build error; PDF renderer errors preserve an older output.

preview.description: Render phone-sized (default 412x915 CSS px at 2x scale) PNG screenshots of pages inside <epub> to folder <out> using headless Chrome with scripts disabled and external requests blocked.

exit_codes.2: Invalid arguments, missing Node/Puppeteer (--no-node), or invalid EPUB.

install-tools.description: Downloaded uv, pandoc, EPUBCheck, and Node.js binaries are checked against pinned SHA-256 checksums. Java uses a suitable installed runtime or the latest Temurin 21 build, verified with the checksum returned by its API. Mermaid-cli and Ace have pinned top-level npm versions; their dependencies resolve during installation.

pdf_status: Unreleased; source checkout with pdf extra required. Version 0.1.1 lacks PDF support.
